_comment: A/B benchmark that calls the models DIRECTLY (no server) via their LangChain client. The most self-contained option: just set credentials in the environment. Run with: nodewatch ab-run --config examples/ab_config.model.example.json --local --db nodewatch.db. NOTE: this calls the models and incurs real API cost.

model._comment_provider: anthropic → ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (+ pip install langchain-anthropic). For AWS Bedrock use "bedrock" with AWS_* creds (+ pip install langchain-aws); for OpenAI use "openai" with OPENAI_API_KEY (+ pip install langchain-openai).
model.system: You are a concise, helpful assistant.

experiment._comment_pause_check: Set pause_check to true (default message) or a custom string to require a user confirmation before the run spends anything. Over MCP this makes run_ab_session return status=confirmation_required until called again with confirm=true; on the CLI it prompts y/N (skip with --yes).
